name: Caves and Ice Age Art in the Swabian Jura
description: In the Swabian Jura of southern Germany, six caves sheltered some of Europe's first modern humans during the last ice age. Their finds include tiny carved mammoths, horses and cave lions, a lion-headed human figure, a female statuette and bone flutes. At up to 43,000 years old, they rank among the oldest known artworks and musical instruments.
